description: Generate a long-form LinkedIn (Pulse) or X article, written fresh in that platform's style. TEXT ONLY: the article comes with empty image slots (a cover plus 2-5 inline), each carrying a prompt. LinkedIn: 1,200-2,500 words, first-person expert voice, keyword-front-loaded title (it becomes the Pulse URL slug). Pulse articles are indexed by Google and cited by AI answer engines, so this is an SEO/GEO play. X: 800-2,000 words, punchy short paragraphs, hook title, reach-oriented (not reliably indexed). Source: pass `topic`, or `seoBriefId` (its keyword and outline guide the piece), or `sourceBlogArticleId`. A blog article is RESEARCH INPUT ONLY (facts, citations) — the article is written fresh with a different angle and structure, never a rewrite of the blog. Never paste a blog verbatim into LinkedIn: it can outrank the brand's own blog. There is NO publishing API. The result is a paste kit: get_social_article returns title, subtitle, body (HTML and markdown with [Image N] markers), cover and inline image URLs, and a teaser post. The user pastes it into the LinkedIn/X editor themselves, then you call update_social_article with `publishedUrl`. Credit cost: 25 credits, text only. Images are separate: after reviewing the text, offer the user image generation (generate_social_article_image per slot, or generate_social_article_images for all empty slots, 30 credits each), or picking existing brand assets via update_social_article (coverImage / inlineImages, free). Ask before spending credits on images. Async — returns { articleId, operationId }. Poll get_job(operationId, wait: true) until state is 'completed', then call get_social_article.

imageCount.description: Inline image slots, 2 to 5 (default 3), plus a cover slot. Slots start empty; images bill separately (30 credits each) when generated.

language.description: Output language for this generation, as a BCP-47 code. One of: en (English), es (Spanish), pt-BR (Portuguese (Brazil)), de (German), fr (French), cs (Czech). Omit to use the brand's configured content language (English if unset) — do NOT pass 'en' just to mean 'unspecified'. Does not translate anything already generated. Applies to this article only.

seoBriefId.description: SEO brief id (seo_list_briefs): its keyword and outline guide the article.

sourceBlogArticleId.description: Existing blog article id (list_blogs). Used as RESEARCH INPUT ONLY (facts, citations): the article is written fresh in the platform's style, never rewritten from the blog text.

targetKeyword.description: LinkedIn only: keyword front-loaded in the title (it becomes the Pulse URL slug).

topic.description: What the article is about. Required unless sourceBlogArticleId or seoBriefId is given.

voiceProfileId.description: Voice profile id (list_voices) to apply to the draft.

name: generate_social_article
